outcome_evidence: The oven is initially closed in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot aligns with the door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward during frames 68–82, visibly exposing the oven interior. In frames 100–112, image and left_ego_image show the door remaining fully lowered and open as the gripper withdraws; wrist_image also shows the open door beside the tabletop. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is established.
